layers.role: Crowd, room, back floor and a completed floor underneath the middle layer for overlap
layers.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background reconstruction. Create the BACK PARALLAX LAYER from this exact approved Eugene disco artwork. One full-bleed OPAQUE image at the EXACT SAME 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas. Preserve the original room composition, crowd arrangement, perspective, floor tile grid and colors. Do not move the camera, crop or re-center the crowd.

KEEP THE CROWD AND BACKGROUND: the same eight-to-ten adult dancers and clapping onlookers around the rear of the open dance circle, their original clothing, sizes, positions, poses and faces. Keep the purple/navy disco atmosphere, magenta and cyan beams, and the small colored mirror-ball reflections scattered around the room, except the specifically removed amber left spotlight described below. Maintain the open dancing space centrally. Reconstruct any small portions of the existing crowd hidden behind Eugene naturally, without adding an extra central hero or extra foreground people. Keep background people subordinate and darker than the hero in the original. No new dancers filling the open dance circle.

KEEP AND COMPLETE THE ENTIRE DANCE FLOOR, including the far floor around the crowd and a seamless hidden continuation all the way across the bottom of the canvas. The middle layer will cover the near portion, but the background must be filled underneath it for parallax overlap. Match the exact original neon checkerboard tile perspective, grid placement and pink/cyan/gold color arrangement. Remove Eugene's cast shadow and his particular mirrored body/foot reflections from the floor, then restore the ordinary floor reflections of the room lighting in their place. Keep crowd reflections where appropriate.

REMOVE EUGENE COMPLETELY: no pink unicorn, horn, mane, turtleneck, hands, trousers, shoes, silhouette or ghost reflection. Repaint the vacated area with a seamless continuation of the dark purple disco atmosphere, unobtrusive natural existing background details and correct floor. Also REMOVE THE UPPER-RIGHT MIRRORED DISCO BALL and its small hanging attachment, the large gold starburst at its upper-left, and its immediate circular halo. Fill the vacated ball area with the surrounding purple room backdrop. Keep the lower/background magenta rays that belong to the room, but do not leave a round ball-shaped patch. Also REMOVE THE DISTINCT GOLDEN SPOTLIGHT CONE that enters from the top-left corner and angles diagonally toward Eugene; this specific beam has its own foreground layer. Fill that upper-left cone area with the same deep violet/navy room. Do not leave amber cone-shaped haze or a duplicate spotlight. Small distant reflected colored squares can remain, and the floor's overall golden illumination stays natural.

This is a clean scene plate, not a new disco illustration. Preserve approved polished angular low-poly style, dark jewel-color room, celebratory crowd, exact horizon and floor perspective. No title, labels, number, border, transparent holes or watermark. The whole canvas must be opaque and completed behind removed elements so it can support the two moving transparent layers above.

layers.role: Eugene plus the near dance floor, his foot shadows and reflections; feathered floor join
layers.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the MIDDLE PARALLAX LAYER from this exact approved Eugene disco artwork. One transparent RGBA PNG, EXACT 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas and pixel registration. Keep retained artwork in its original position, scale, shape and pose; do not crop, re-center, enlarge, redesign or re-render the character differently.

KEEP THE COMPLETE EUGENE exactly as he appears: tiny black beady eyes, simple pink long angular horse head and neck, lavender muzzle and little goofy smile, single pearlescent horn, short blocky rainbow mane, pale aqua turtleneck with sage collar/cuffs and unicorn emblem, butter-yellow pants, pink shoes, the same two bent arms with relaxed hands and bent-knee stepping dance pose. Preserve the approved slim nonmuscular anatomy, exact silhouette, all original painted light patches and facial appearance. NO brows, lashes, larger eyes or humanized face. Clean transparent spaces between his legs, under his bent arms and around his head.

ALSO KEEP THE FRONT PART OF THE DANCE FLOOR as one continuous full-width band at the bottom of the same image. Preserve the original neon checkerboard tile positions, perspective, magenta/cyan/gold illumination, Eugene's foot contact shadows and his reflections beneath his shoes. Retain floor fully opaque below approximately y=1020 to the bottom edge at y=1535. Between approximately y=900 and y=1020, gently feather ONLY the floor's upper/back edge from completely transparent to opaque; this soft overlap allows the far-floor background underneath to move slightly without showing a hard seam. The opaque Eugene cutout itself must stay opaque everywhere, including across this floor transition. Do NOT fade his legs. Keep the floor continuous beneath BOTH feet and all the way to the bottom and side edges, no isolated oval island, pedestal, puzzle shape, or sharply cut horizontal shelf. Remove any crowd feet/body fragments that intersect this retained floor region and continue the existing tiles cleanly in their place.

REMOVE EVERYTHING ELSE TO ACTUAL ALPHA ZERO: all dancers/crowd, all room background, the upper-right disco ball and chain, ball glints, the top-left golden spotlight cone, all freestanding background beam rays and reflected squares. Do retain the light already PAINTED ON Eugene and on the kept foreground floor because that is part of their shading. Above the floor blend region, nothing may remain except Eugene himself. The background is transparent, not black/navy. No crowd remnants under his arms or through legs; no ball ghost or left light beam left on this layer.

Match source artwork exactly, crisp faceted stylized shapes and original vivid colors. Clean antialiased character edges; true fractional alpha only at silhouette edges and the floor blend. No extraneous outer glow, opaque backdrop, checkerboard printed into pixels, labels, text, border or watermark. Output ONE combined Eugene-plus-near-floor registered layer.

layers.role: Mirrored disco ball, its glint, and the upper-left golden spotlight beam
layers.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the FRONT PARALLAX LAYER from the supplied approved Eugene disco illustration. Return one genuine transparent RGBA PNG on the EXACT SAME 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas. Strict registration: every retained item stays precisely at its existing position, size, perspective and shape. DO NOT crop transparent canvas, recenter objects, resize, rearrange or redesign the composition.

KEEP ONLY TWO GROUPS:
1. The mirrored DISCO BALL in the UPPER-RIGHT corner, including its tiny hanging attachment at the top, all of its colored glass mirror facets, and the prominent warm golden glint just beside its upper-left edge. This is the original silver/multicolored mirror ball, NOT a new smooth crystal orb. Retain its original partially edge-adjacent framing and exact position. The sphere and fixture remain opaque; the small natural glow and star glint have smoothly feathered true alpha.
2. The WARM GOLDEN SPOTLIGHT BEAM entering from the TOP-LEFT corner and slanting diagonally down toward the center of the room behind Eugene. Isolate just this upper-left amber light cone, with its bright origin off-canvas at the upper-left and its long soft widening falloff. Reconstruct the continuous light cone where Eugene currently hides part of it; when layered it should gently illuminate whatever lies underneath. The beam is TRANSLUCENT LIGHT, not an opaque yellow polygon: retain natural partially transparent amber/gold color, low to moderate opacity through most of its area, softly fading to alpha zero toward both side edges and the bottom end. It must look good with ordinary normal alpha-over compositing, without carrying dark purple room pixels. Keep the beam primarily in its original upper-left region, avoiding a new huge orange wash across the whole canvas.

REMOVE EVERYTHING ELSE TO ALPHA ZERO: Eugene in full, his horn, mane, body, clothing, shoes, ALL crowd members, the entire dance floor and reflections, all purple/navy background, cyan beams, magenta beams, scattered reflected squares and all other scenery. The bottom half should be empty except any faint natural taper of the top-left spotlight. Do not retain dark backdrop halos around the ball or beam. The two kept groups should remain spatially separate with clear transparent negative space between them. This layer contains NO character and NO floor.

Maintain the exact approved low-poly faceted disco-ball rendering and golden light color. Clean antialiasing on the ball; real fractional alpha for glints and light beam. No black/white/colored background, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no text, labels or border. This is a faithful full-canvas extraction for parallax, not a fresh illustration.

compositing: Normal alpha-over: background, middle, front. The spotlight uses partial transparency.
notes: All three retain the approved 1024 x 1536 source canvas. Middle floor overlaps the complete background floor. Keep relative floor-layer movement modest to limit checkerboard-grid misalignment.
